press_references.value: Pyka and Foundation for California Community Colleges Awarded CARB and CEC Grant for Commercial-Scale Zero-Emission Autonomous Aviation Demonstration in California Agriculture

partnership_announcements.description: Pyka is partnering with the Foundation for California Community Colleges, Victoria Island Farms, Ogive Technology, NPower California, and the Bay Area Community College Consortium on the California Zero-Emission Aviation Demonstration Project to deploy autonomous electric crop-protection aircraft and workforce programs.

press_references.value: Pyka and SLC Agrícola Expand Partnership Following Successful Growing Season with Pelican 2

partnership_announcements.description: Pyka and SLC Agrícola expanded their commercial partnership after a successful season using Pyka's Pelican 2 autonomous aircraft, with SLC Agrícola placing a new fleet order to scale operations across multiple farms in Brazil.

press_references.value: Pyka and ADS Collaborate for Future Opportunities to Equip U.S. Government with Large Multi-Mission Autonomous Cargo Aircraft

partnership_announcements.description: Pyka announced a new collaboration with ADS to pursue future opportunities to equip U.S. DoD, federal agencies, and first responders with Pyka’s DropShip large, hybrid‑electric autonomous cargo aircraft.

press_references.value: Pyka Announces Heinen Brothers Agra Services as First U.S. Distributor for Autonomous Crop Protection Aircraft

partnership_announcements.description: Pyka entered its first U.S. distribution agreement with Heinen Brothers Agra Services and its subsidiary Kelly Hills Unmanned Systems to distribute and market the Pelican 2 autonomous agricultural aircraft to U.S. growers.

press_references.value: Pyka Secures Firm Order from Synerjet for 60 Autonomous Crop Protection Aircraft

partnership_announcements.description: Pyka and Synerjet have announced a new partnership, with Synerjet becoming Pyka's first authorized distributor in Brazil for its autonomous crop protection aircraft. Synerjet will handle sales, training, and technical support for the Pelican platform in Brazil.

research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Pyka is engaged in research and development of autonomous electric aircraft, focusing on unmanned aerial vehicle aerial spraying control, as described in methods, systems, and apparatus for controlling chemical spraying by UAVs. Additionally, work on an aircraft propulsion system details a fuselage with wings, booms, and both front and rear propulsion systems. These efforts highlight Pyka’s focus on autonomous aerial spraying and advanced propulsion technologies.

press_references.value: Pyka's DropShip Unlocks Fully Autonomous Low-Altitude Airdrop Capability for Military Logistics

product_launches.description: Pyka unveiled a new fully autonomous low-altitude parachute airdrop capability for its DropShip heavy-lift autonomous aircraft, enabling same-day delivery of critical supplies over long ranges for U.S. and allied forces following a successful demonstration flight.

press_references.value: Pyka's Autonomous DropShip Completes First Flight

product_launches.description: Pyka completed the first flight of DropShip, its next-generation heavy-lift autonomous aircraft for contested logistics and multi-mission operations, marking the program’s initial launch milestone after six months from concept to flight.

product_launches.description: The world's largest autonomous crop protection aircraft with a 300-liter payload, advanced propulsion, and autonomous systems.

press_references.value: Cargo Drones Market: Future Demand and Top Key Players Analysis | 2029

product_launches.description: Pyka, a US aerospace company, launched its Pelican Cargo drone in January 2023. The electric cargo drone is notable for being self-driving and capable of carrying up to 400 lbs over 200 miles, targeting logistics and medical supply transport.

overview_description.description: Pyka is a robotics company on a mission to build the most useful autonomous aircraft on Earth. At the core of every Pyka aircraft is a vertically integrated aircraft-first robotics stack: proprietary flight control software, avionics, high-power density electric motors, motor controllers, batteries, and carbon fiber composite airframes, developed entirely in-house and manufactured in the United States of America. Learn more at www.flypyka.com.
